articles.title: Famous News Anchor Jon Snow Says He Has Alzheimer's — and He's Still Reporting!
articles.summary: Jon Snow, who read the news on TV for 32 years, has Alzheimer's disease. He hid it at first but is now sharing his story to help others. He even made a new film about an environmental disaster in Zambia.

articles.title: Flesh-Eating Maggots Are Back in Texas — and They're After Cows!
articles.summary: A scary fly called the New World screwworm has been found in a calf in Texas. Its maggots eat live flesh. The fly was gone from the U.S. for 60 years, but now it's back and could hurt the $113 billion cattle industry.

articles.title: Buffy and Ted Lasso Star Anthony Head Has Died at 72
articles.summary: Anthony Head, who played Giles in Buffy the Vampire Slayer and appeared in Ted Lasso, died from pneumonia. His daughters said he passed away peacefully with family by his side. He was 72.
